offering_description.value: Cultivates, manufactures and sells licensed cannabis products under its own brands, and sells them to consumers through its own retail dispensaries and to independent dispensaries across several US states.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vape cartridges; edibles; pre-rolls; concentrates

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use consumers and registered medical cannabis patients at its dispensaries

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold at its own dispensaries and wholesale to other licensed retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: grows and processes cannabis into finished products, sold to its own stores and other retailers; brand owner: designs and markets its own cannabis brands sold through dispensaries; retailer: operates dispensaries that sell cannabis products directly to consumers and patients

geography_served.value: US national: Multi-state footprint across several US states, mainly in the Midwest, Northeast, South and West

specialization.value: related lines: flower, vapes, edibles, pre-rolls and concentrates, all cannabis products

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned retail dispensaries selling directly to consumers and patients; partners / resellers: wholesale supply to independent licensed dispensaries

regulatory_exposure.value: high: cannabis cultivation, manufacturing and retail need state licenses, federal Controlled Substances Act and state cannabis regulators apply

notes: State footprint and product lines change over time, and federal cannabis status may shift.
